facts.fact: Les Enjeux Eco reports the national digital services portal is in service with a first phase of 21 digital services, mainly from the Interior, Labour and National Solidarity sectors, and about 650 priority services planned.
The portal carries services of the Interior, Labour and National Solidarity sectors behind one digital identity based on the NIN, per HCN central director Mohamed Louail.

note: No usage figures stated; the 11-16 July 2026 drive gives no count.
